core_contract: Canonical identity, GoalSpec/plan/packet/lease, admission, effects and recovery remain Recursion-owned in both modes.
Route identity binds engine/build/protocol/model/effort/tool/policy/auth/account-class/compaction epoch; never store credentials in evidence.
Base bridge: correlated lifecycle and structured results, bounded streams, explicit refusal, interruption status, ambiguity and usage availability; only task-required controls permit admission.
Optional extensions negotiate independently; unknown is not unsupported or zero. No universal parity promise.
No engine event grants authority. Resource-consuming fences and containment determine permissible effects.
command_bridge: Proposed core /status, /goal, /pause, /route, /help remain Recursion commands; their exact spelling is not ratified here.
Proposed /engine/<engine>/<command> namespace retains native semantics; collisions with core names refuse import; aliases carry versioned argument schemas and losses.
Compile Recursion custom tools to supported MCP/dynamic-tool interfaces only with mapped grants. Unsupported imports are visible and inert.
Target queue and steer separately. Bind turn ID and route epoch; stale target refuses. A terminal keystroke is never reported as structured steering.
Native compaction commands cannot silently replace the authoritative capsule or compaction governor. Report engine-local result separately from canonical acceptance.
